name: Dance
notes: Dance minors are required to take a total of 26 credits: at least 10 in embodied practice, at least 12 in critical thinking, and at least 2 in somatic awareness.

Requirements are stated in CREDITS and many DANC courses are 1-2 credits rather than 4. Each group below converts its credit minimum into a course count using the modal credit value of that group's own option list; confirm your credit totals with the program.
CREDIT GAP: the three category minimums sum to 24 of the stated 26 credits, so about one more 2-credit dance course is needed beyond what the groups below model.

NOT A COURSE REQUIREMENT: Experience in Technical Production - a combination of red (13+ hours), yellow (6-12 hours) and green (0-5 hours) jobs on program productions. For the dance minor: one red job, OR one yellow plus one green job, OR three green jobs.
NOT A COURSE REQUIREMENT: students enrolled in any dance course must attend at least two program-sponsored performances and two program-sponsored workshops each semester.
The catalog splits DANC 250 into sections DANC 250A and DANC 250B, and carries DANC 365 as DANC 365A/B/C; all are listed as options.
The dance MAJOR is a separate pair of entries (major-danc-cep-ba and major-danc-ds-ba).

requirementGroups.label: Embodied practice: one 4-credit practice course
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Embodied Practice Courses. Students are required to take at least 10 credits of embodied practice courses. Choose one or more of the following courses: DANC 204; DANC 250; DANC 251; DANC 252; DANC 253; DANC 254; DANC 285 (4 credits each)

requirementGroups.label: Embodied practice: remaining 6 credits
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Additional embodied practice courses: DANC 102; DANC 110; DANC 116; DANC 126; DANC 140; DANC 145; DANC 150; DANC 171; DANC 181; DANC 182; DANC 185; DANC 187; DANC 188; DANC 189; DANC 190; DANC 197; DANC 212/MUR 210; DANC 215; DANC 240; DANC 266; DANC 267; DANC 268; DANC 269; DANC 271; DANC 273; DANC 281; DANC 283; DANC 290; DANC 365
requirementGroups.note: Almost every course here is 2 credits, so three of them supply the remaining 6 of the 10 embodied-practice credits.

requirementGroups.label: Critical thinking: creative expression (4 credits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Critical Thinking Courses. Students are required to take at least 12 credits of Critical Thinking courses. Creative Expression: Choose at least four credits from the following: DANC 104 (2); DANC 109 (2); DANC 160 (2); DANC 237 (2); DANC 241 (4); DANC 242 (2); DANC 243/SART 243/FMST 223/DMST 281 (4); DANC 245 (4); DANC 247 (4); DANC 249 (4); DANC 278 (4); DANC 279 (1); DANC 377 (4); DANC 378 (4); DANC 379 (4); DANC 380 (3); DANC 385 (2); DANC 397/DANC 398 (1)
requirementGroups.note: 4-credit options are listed first: one of them satisfies the category outright.

requirementGroups.label: Critical thinking: context, citizenship and cultural competency
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Context, Citizenship, and Cultural Competency. Choose at least four credits of the following: DANC 155; DANC 195; DANC 202; DANC 228; DANC 233; DANC 235; DANC 247; DANC 248; DANC 249; DANC 296; DANC 305 (4 credits each)

requirementGroups.label: Critical thinking: remaining 4 credits
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students are required to take at least 12 credits of Critical Thinking courses.
requirementGroups.note: Four credits each from creative expression and from context leaves 4 of the 12 credits, which this third course from either category supplies.

requirementGroups.label: Somatic awareness (2 credits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Somatic Awareness Courses.
